name: aqawan1
_fault_auto_clear: Automatic fault clearing is the safety supervisor's policy (safety.fault_auto_clear in sites/minerva/aqawan1.json; docs/aqawan.md). This server refuses an automatic clear unless both shutters are closed, and never clears an E-stop or an emergency close latch automatically.
_emergency_close: The observer console's close-only channel (docs/console.md): replace the hash with the SHA-256 of the console's token (python -m robofast_core.emergency token).
